crownPassive.name: Shape-shifter
crownPassive.text: The first time Loki would die, he survives on 1 Health and swaps places with your highest-Health other hero, who becomes the Crown.

bond.name: Unbound
bond.text: The first time Loki dies, he returns two upkeeps later on 4 Health, if his slot is empty, and deals 2 to every enemy card.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard Ranged attack: damage equal to Attack, on any enemy card.

actions.name: Mistletoe
actions.text: A Ranged attack for 3 on any enemy card, ignoring Guard.

actions.name: Crown thief
actions.text: The enemy Crown passes to their highest-Health hero: the two swap places, and the new one becomes the Crown. Once per fight.
